finalText:
Migration's done. 12 files were still on `db.query` — one repo or service file in each of analytics, orders, billing, support, catalog, and accounts. All switched to `db.execute({ sql, params })`, matching the pattern already used everywhere else.

Left untouched, on purpose:
- `cache.query` calls — different object, not part of this migration.
- `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` — vendored code, not ours to edit.

`node verify.js` passes clean.
